description: Lists up to 10 mountain passes and famous roads for motorcycles in one country, with their names, locations and elevations. Give a point and a radius to list the nearest first, or a name to filter; otherwise the most notable come first.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example DE

near.description: Optional point; results are ordered by distance from it

radius_km.description: Search radius around near, in kilometres (default 100)

name: find_motorcycle_passes
title: Find motorcycle passes
